modos.descricao: Burlar protocolo alpha e engajar qualquer personagem

params.descricao: Circunventa o ciclo normal de alpha, engaja qualquer personagem/ally/inimigo. Interrompe o ciclo alpha se jogado durante Combat Phase (nao interrompe combate ja iniciado)

_metadata.texto_original: The character can circumvent the normal combat protocol and engage any character, ally or enemy in play.  If played during the Combat Phase of a turn, Sneak Attack can interrupt the normal alpha attack cycle, but cannot interrupt a combat that has already started.
